svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make three. Cut 335 mm of 40 mm OD PVC pipe, ends square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Deburr both ends; chamfer the outside edges 1 mm so it slides

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: down the 41.9 mm bore of the stake pipe without catching.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Its length sets the capsule depth: capsule centre 400 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: below ground when the stand tube sits on the end cap floor.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: drops down the pipe and stands on the cap floor, 0.95 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: clear of the bore all round. The capsule's lower collar sits on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its top rim; the capsule itself is 1 mm inside the rim.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the length on the tube; check it with a tape before cutting,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: since a 10 mm error moves the capsule 10 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: 335 mm long, within 2 mm; slides freely down an offcut
